input.rationale: Section 12.b gives a TrueLink indemnity, but it is confined to claims "arising out of any breach by TrueLink of this Agreement or any failure by TrueLink in the performance of any of its obligations or agreements hereunder" (p0075). It does not cover third-party claims that the Hosting Services, Support Services or deliverables infringe IP rights, nor TrueLink's breach of law, a data breach caused by TrueLink, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct as independent triggers, and no IP indemnity appears elsewhere. By contrast the Client indemnity at 12.a is open-ended. The clause therefore fails the fallback. The redline inserts the preferred TrueLink defence and indemnity of Client and its affiliates with notice, control and cooperation, and limits Client's indemnity to Client Content and Client's violation of law.

ops.text: c. TrueLink shall defend and indemnify Client and its affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (i) an allegation that the Hosting Services, the Support Services or any deliverable furnished by TrueLink infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right; (ii) TrueLink's breach of applicable law; (iii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Client Content caused by TrueLink; or (iv) TrueLink's gross negligence or willful misconduct. Client shall give TrueLink prompt written notice of the claim, TrueLink shall control the defense of the claim, and Client shall provide reasonable cooperation.
Client's indemnity under this Section 12.a is limited to claims arising out of Client Content and claims arising out of any violation by Client of any state or federal law, rule or regulation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink's indemnity at 12.b reaches only its own breach of this Agreement, so we have added a TrueLink indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, data breach caused by TrueLink and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with notice, control and cooperation, and limited Client's indemnity at 12.a to Client Content and Client's violation of law.
proposal.summary: Add TrueLink indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, data breach and wilful misconduct; narrow Client's indemnity
